news.headline: Coca-Cola Bets $10 Billion on U.S. Infrastructure to Drive Growth
news.summary: The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO) plans to invest $10 billion in U.S. infrastructure from 2026 through 2030, reinforcing its manufacturing, distribution, and bottling network in one of its most important markets. The commitment is system-wide and therefore includes investments by Coca-Cola’s bottling partners, rather than representing $10 billion of Coca-Cola’s own capital expenditure.
